name: @w6w-apps/browseai
description: Run Browse AI robots, poll the tasks they create, manage monitors, bulk runs and webhooks, on the Browse AI API v2.

w6w.longDescription:
Browse AI turns website scraping into an API: robots record what to extract from a page, and this app runs them, polls the results, and manages everything that keeps a robot scraping on a schedule. A single run creates a task carrying the captured text, lists, and screenshots; a monitor re-runs a robot automatically and diffs the result over time; and a bulk run can kick off up to tens of thousands of task variations from one call — useful for a workflow that needs to scrape many similar pages at once, such as a list of product URLs.

It also manages the supporting pieces: updating the cookies a robot uses to reach content behind a login, registering webhooks so a workflow is notified as tasks complete instead of polling for them, and reading the current status of Browse AI's own task queue. Task and bulk-run history can be searched and filtered by date, which matters on an active robot generating a large volume of runs.
